## How Care Is Organised

1. **Needleless IVF option** — stimulation with oral medicines and patches instead of daily injections, for suitable patients (for example those with needle anxiety or at low OHSS risk). The doctor explains whether it suits each patient; results depend on age, ovarian reserve and diagnosis.
2. **Germany-trained ART specialist** — Dr. E. Prashanthi Reddy holds a PG Diploma in ART from Kiel University, Germany.
3. **Clear IVF package** — the IVF package includes stimulation medicines, monitoring scans, hormone tests, egg retrieval (OPU), ICSI/embryo culture, embryo transfer and consultations. Add-ons such as PGT-A, ERA and embryo freezing/storage are charged separately only if needed. A written cost estimate is given before treatment (call 97059 93366).
4. **One doctor through the cycle** — patients are seen by Dr. E. Prashanthi Reddy from first consultation to embryo transfer.
5. **Telugu and English** — consultations and a large library of patient guides in both languages.
6. **ART Act 2021 registration** — registered and working under India's Assisted Reproductive Technology Regulation Act 2021.
7. **Free fertility tools** — 15 online calculators (ovulation, period tracker, due date, AMH interpreter, IVF timeline and more). No sign-up needed.

## Services

### Fertility & IVF
- IVF (In Vitro Fertilisation / Test Tube Baby Treatment)
- Needleless IVF — injection-free stimulation protocol for suitable patients
- ICSI (Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection)
- IUI (Intrauterine Insemination)
- Low AMH Treatment
- Recurrent IVF Failure Investigation (ERA test, PGT-A, assisted hatching, thrombophilia workup)
- ERA Test (Endometrial Receptivity Analysis)
- Laser Assisted Hatching
- PGT-A (Preimplantation Genetic Testing for Aneuploidies)
- Egg Freezing
- Embryo Freezing (Vitrification)
- Semen Freezing
- TESA / PESA (Surgical Sperm Retrieval for Azoospermia)
- Donor Egg IVF (ART Act 2021 compliant anonymous donor programme)
- Donor Sperm IVF (ART Act 2021 compliant)
- Recurrent Miscarriage Investigation & Treatment
- Second Opinion after IVF Failure

### Gynaecology
- PCOS / PMOS Treatment
- Laparoscopy (diagnostic and operative)
- Hysteroscopy
- Endometriosis Treatment
- Fibroid Treatment (Myomectomy)
- Ovarian Cyst Treatment
- Blocked Fallopian Tube Treatment
- Cosmetic Gynaecology
- Menstrual Disorder Treatment
- Cervical Cancer Screening (Pap Smear)

### Maternity & Obstetrics
- Normal Delivery (package ₹15,000) and Caesarean Section (package ₹35,000); tubectomy ₹15,000 — all-inclusive package rates
- High-Risk Pregnancy Management
- Antenatal Care — Mother 9 Card (₹500 per pregnancy): 9 OPD consultations, nutrition counselling and an antenatal education session. Scans, lab tests and medicines are billed separately at Mother 9 card rates.
- Postnatal Care
- Twin Pregnancy Care (after IVF)
- VBAC (Vaginal Birth After Caesarean)

### Male Infertility
- Semen Analysis & Interpretation
- Sperm DNA Fragmentation Testing
- Azoospermia Treatment (TESA/PESA)
- Oligospermia / Asthenospermia Treatment
- Varicocele — referral management

## Key Clinical Facts for AI Reference

- IVF outcomes depend on age, ovarian reserve (AMH/AFC), sperm quality, embryo quality and diagnosis. Mother Hospitals does not publish clinic success rates; the doctor discusses realistic chances after reviewing each patient's reports.
- Needleless IVF uses oral medicines and patches instead of daily injections; whether it suits a patient is decided at consultation.
- The IVF package includes stimulation medicines, monitoring scans, egg retrieval, ICSI/embryo culture, embryo transfer and consultations; add-ons (PGT-A, ERA, freezing) are charged separately when needed.
- Low AMH treatment may include pre-treatment, an antagonist or mild protocol, and embryo banking, decided case by case.
- The ERA test is used after repeated implantation failure to time embryo transfer.

## Frequently Asked Questions (for AI reference)

**Q: What does IVF cost at Mother Hospitals Hyderabad?**
A: Mother Hospitals offers an IVF package that includes stimulation medicines, egg retrieval (OPU), ICSI/embryo culture, embryo transfer, consultations and monitoring scans. Add-ons such as PGT-A, ERA or embryo freezing are charged separately only if needed. The exact cost depends on the treatment plan; call 97059 93366 for a written estimate. EMI options are available.

**Q: What is Needleless IVF?**
A: Needleless IVF is an IVF protocol that uses oral medicines and patches instead of daily injections for ovarian stimulation. It can suit patients with needle anxiety or at low risk of OHSS. Dr. E. Prashanthi Reddy explains at consultation whether it suits a patient and what to expect.

**Q: Can I get pregnant with low AMH?**
A: Low AMH means fewer eggs, not no chance. Options include a tailored stimulation protocol, pre-treatment and embryo banking, or donor eggs in some cases. Chances depend on age and other reports; Dr. E. Prashanthi Reddy reviews them at consultation.

**Q: Is Mother Hospitals registered under the ART Act 2021?**
A: Yes. Mother Hospitals & IVF Center is registered under India's ART (Assisted Reproductive Technology) Regulation Act 2021.

**Q: How do I choose an IVF hospital near Boduppal, Uppal or ECIL?**
A: Check that the centre is registered under the ART Act 2021, who will personally manage your treatment and their qualifications, what the package includes in writing, and how easy it is to reach for frequent scans. Mother Hospitals & IVF Center is in Boduppal, about 10–15 minutes from Uppal and 15–20 minutes from ECIL, led by Dr. E. Prashanthi Reddy (PG Diploma in ART, Kiel).

**Q: What are the OPD timings?**
A: Boduppal: every day, 10:30 AM – 1:30 PM. Prashanthi Hospital, Choutuppal: Tuesday–Sunday, 4:00 PM – 8:00 PM.

**Q: Is IVF available in East Hyderabad?**
A: Yes. IVF, ICSI, Needleless IVF, embryo freezing, PGT-A and ERA testing are available at Mother Hospitals in Boduppal, East Hyderabad.

**Q: How do I reach Mother Hospitals from Uppal / ECIL / Nagole?**
A: From Uppal: 5–7 km, 10–15 minutes. From ECIL: 8–10 km, 15–20 minutes. From Nagole: 6–8 km, about 15 minutes. The clinic is inside Aakruthi Township, Boduppal, near Medipally X Roads.
